repair.cause: Whole-source replacement can remove the original preferred birth fragment while new text exists in the same source in its distinct empty fragment. An old captured endpoint may have no surviving owner on its original side of that physical gap.
repair.contract: Retain every successful original mapping. Only a missing preferred fragment plus the original Anchor failure enables same-coordinate opposite-side lookup, then the known fragment gap. Original affinity is retained, including floating source-start Before at zero.
repair.compatibility: Affected old readers still reject newly supported replacement checkpoints. Exact old-reader refusal is asserted, not hidden by rebuilding its reference binary. Host room participants, restored backups and recovery readers must meet the fixed runtime minimum; downgrade of affected checkpoints is unsupported.
